ownership_summary: Owned by a 100% local group of the Taylor family (Enterprise Holdings), led by Carolyn Kindle as controlling owner and CEO, and the Kavanaugh family (Jim Kavanaugh, World Wide Technology); the first majority female-owned club in MLS. The group paid $200m to bring the expansion team to St. Louis in 2019. No institutional investor is reported.
